text: In the conceptor C = R (R + alpha^-2 I)^-1, what happens as the aperture alpha -> infinity?
choices: C -> R, the raw correlation matrix
C -> I, imposing no constraint on the reservoir dynamics
C -> the orthogonal projector onto the null space of R
explanation: As alpha -> infinity, alpha^-2 -> 0, so C -> R R^-1 = I and the conceptor has no effect. The opposite limit alpha -> 0 gives C -> 0 (all activity suppressed); C never equals R itself nor a null-space projector.
